scientific_integrity: Exact algebra and rigorous mathematical derivation with independent finite rational checks; numerical checks are not used as proofs of infinite orbit properties. No external independent audit.
scientific_limitations: The exact scalar Bayesian equation was released as arXiv:2405.19128v1 on 2024-05-29; the earliest verified related public account is the 2023-10-26 Physics interview describing the same opinion-model research, but not its formula. Only the fixed-multiplier, uncoupled agent and per-agent update-count time are treated. Irrational invariant law unique only on recurrent interior set; boundary opinions are absorbing. Known circle-rotation and Sturmian theorems credited. Literature originality is best-knowledge, not independently certified.
title: Sturmian belief switching and exact invariant statistics in an anti-confirmation update
